name: AirNav Ireland
notes: airnav.ie home page: 'AirNav Ireland provides air traffic management services' (air traffic control, flight information, alerting, aeronautical information, North Atlantic communications) in Irish-controlled airspace. Per the earlier CAA-batch search results it took over air navigation services from the IAA on 1 May 2023 (not stated on the pages read here). Logos are PNG files served by airnav.ie in its page layout (tier 2, website-served): the mint-and-white colour logo is designed for dark backgrounds, plus an all-white variant. No brand page, press kit or logo terms located (the /media page is news), so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
